payload.headline: The task successfully implemented complex INDEX/MATCH formulas and manual XML value injection to ensure data persistence in environments without a calculation engine.
payload.evidence: To satisfy data_only=True requirements in environments without a calculation engine, manually injecting <v> tags into the sheet's XML remains the most reliable method. The process requires identifying the correct sheetN.xml via xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels and handling the http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main namespace. The formula =SUMPRODUCT(H35:H40,H26:H31)/SUM(H26:H31) was correctly implemented to calculate the bed-capacity-weighted flow.
payload.mediator_reasoning: The task was successful, but the reflection provides a high-level summary of the architectural approach (XML injection and complex formula mapping) which is useful for the Planner if similar Excel-heavy tasks arise.
